lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: The Albertsons Net Lease 1 sale closed 2026-09-14 for $300.0M ($97.9M net cash plus $200M of debt assumed). The 8-K pro forma shows a gain on sale of $60.4M, about $0.48 per share on ~126.8M shares, and a GAAP equity lift from $862.98M to $923.38M, roughly +$0.47 per share on Q2's $6.81 book value. findings.finding: The loan book grew into Q3: just over $3B in late July (from $2.9B at the Q2 release), with $117M closed after quarter end, $178M in execution, and July originations nearly equal to all of Q2. BRSP then closed the $960M BRSP 2026-FL4 CRE CLO on 2026-10-16 (A notes at SOFR+1.40%) and redeemed the 2024-FL2 CLO with cash on hand. Higher average earning assets support Q3 ADE at or above Q2's $0.13, which beats the $0.11 Benzinga/EW bar and is in line with Yahoo's $0.14. Partial offset: lost Albertsons NOI of ~$10M per half-year, net of 4.77% interest on $200M, for the last ~2 weeks of the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 printed $0.13 ADE (a beat on Benzinga, a miss vs Yahoo's $0.15) and the stock went -4.58. Q1 2026 printed $0.14 against higher estimates and the stock went -4.45. This name has not paid for in-line ADE.

findings.finding: Dividend coverage is the open question. Q2 ADE was $0.13 against the $0.16 dividend (81%). Management said the Albertsons sale delays full coverage by about two quarters, to Q2/Q3 2027. At $3.665 the $0.16 quarterly payout yields 17.5%, which prices a cut. The Q3 dividend was already declared on 2026-09-14 and the Q4 one is normally declared mid-December (prior declarations June 15 and Sept 14), so a formal cut is unlikely in this release. But BRSP did announce its 2024 cut ($0.20 to $0.16) inside a Q2 earnings release, and call commentary on the Q4 dividend can move the stock either way.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2024-07-30 release carried the cut to $0.16 alongside a -$0.53 GAAP loss (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1717547/000171754724000068/brspq224earningsreleasev.htm). The baseline does not isolate that day's move.

On 2026-09-23, after DMC last spoke, Hunting said Hunting Titan was ranked the No.1 preferred supplier for the second year running (Kimberlite) and pointed to 'growing preference for Hunting Titan's shaped charges and perforating guns in the North American land market'. Hunting's H1 update had already reported Perforating Systems 'significantly ahead of expectations' on North American share gains. On the Q2 call DMC's CEO said 'Pricing is still hard to come by... no price increases, and it's very competitive'. The Q2 Dyna margin of 8.4% (13.4% a year earlier) included a $1.5M tariff refund that is not in the Q3 guide.

findings.finding: The Arcadia minority holder's put on the remaining 40% has been exercisable since 2026-09-06, at a floor value of $187.1M against DMC's market cap of about $110M. DMC can settle in cash, or 20% cash and 80% preferred stock (3% dividend, convertible 1:1, conversion and voting capped at 19.9%, proportionate annual redemptions from 2027-06-23). On the Q2 call the CEO said 'we have absolutely no idea if our partner will stay in the joint venture'. EDGAR shows no 8-K from DMC since the 2026-07-29 print (latest filing a 13G on 2026-08-14), so whether it has been exercised is undisclosed. The Q3 release, 10-Q subsequent-events note or call will very likely address it. The sign is unknowable; this is the largest variance item on the name.
